initial-attempt: Initial UI proof passed but batch-start connection closed; the persisted batch completed and was collected without creating a replacement batch. Frames exposed long-source clipping and late citation reveals.
stale-runtime-attempt: Server modules remained cached after edits; outputs did not prove the revised backend emitter. Preserved as an invalid verification attempt for those edits.
resumed-attempt: The batch from the first fresh-runtime font stall was resumed after preserving its home and restarting the isolated server with tracing. Three films completed; these predate family diversity and call-column framing fixes.
compile-stall.log: Initial fresh server remained in compile; direct isolated compilation of the same pinned input took about one second. Cancellation was requested but did not terminate compilation before the saved server was stopped.
second-compile-stall.log: Reproduced the fresh Studio font stall. Browser verifier was intentionally terminated with its saved container; exit 137.
traced-font-stall.log: Checkpoints reached normalized-fonts and stopped before resolved-fonts. Browser verifier was intentionally terminated with its saved container; exit 137.
resolution: Local font requests lacked a timeout; executeRenderJob omitted the abort signal passed to runCompileStage. Both were fixed. The final browser run completed without restart, and a real subsequent Studio batch cancelled during compile in 726 ms.
font-retries-path-error.log: The first Bun test filter lacked ./ and also matched the frozen source tree. It failed resolution there; the explicit owned file invocation then passed. No frozen file was changed.
failure.json: Historical browser failure diagnostic; it does not describe the final successful browser run.
